create_identity_rotation: create a Rot3Array identity matrix of a given shape using the identity class method
build_rotation_from_quaternion: build a Rot3Array from quaternion components w, x, y, z with optional normalization
apply_rotation_to_point: apply a Rot3Array rotation matrix to a Vec3Array point and return the transformed point
compose_rotations: compose two Rot3Array rotation matrices together using the matmul operator
sample_random_rotation: sample a uniform random Rot3Array using Haar measure with a JAX random key
